panel.empty: Select a race on the map to see its candidates, their chances and some background.

note.blend: Top-two primary blend: it moves {share} as much as the national environment.

note.uncontested: Uncontested: only one candidate is running.
note.DvD: Two Democrats: the seat stays D whatever the environment.
note.RvR: Two Republicans: the seat stays R whatever the environment.

note.independent.D: No Democrat is running: the independent takes the Democratic side, so a shift toward D helps them.
